title: docs(qa): withdraw the retired sys_account.issuer from two checklist carriers
body:
Fixes #19217
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Two QA-checklist carriers still required or cited `sys_account.issuer`, a column that retired with better-auth 1.7.3 (durable record: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.sys-account-issuer-retired.ts`). Docs/QA only; no code, no published package source.

1. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json`, item `identity-auth.linked-accounts-social`: the ORACLE. The step 「issuer stamped」 and the first acceptance clause's verify 「issuer is stamped」 are both withdrawn. The same shape PR #19213 used for `approvals.json`: the reason is kept (the step now says `(provider_id, account_id)` is the whole account identity and names the retirement's migration entry), and the verify says an issuer-less row is the healthy shape, never a FAIL. `revision` 1 -> 2 with an appended `history` entry; revision 1's history entry is untouched.
2. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` section 6, the "second signed-up (non-admin) user in seeds" row: the closing-evidence clause "issuer derived from the dev admin's own row" is withdrawn. The file's own rule is append-never-rewrite, so the correction is made visibly in place (the pattern section 10's E2 row already uses): the row says what the seed does today (`ensureCredentialAccount` -> better-auth `internalAdapter.createAccount`, keyed on `(provider_id, account_id)`, read at `examples/app-showcase/src/security/seed-approval-demo.ts` `ensureCredentialAccount` and the comment above its call site), and records that it used to claim an issuer derivation, withdrawn with this card.

## Premise, re-measured on `c1185240` (branch base)

- `identity-auth.json` step at `:1119` and verify at `:1128` carried the dead requirement (card said `:1118` / `:1127`).
- `FOLLOW-UPS.md:151` carried the falsified clause.
- The corroboration still holds: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-demo-personas-loginable.dogfood.test.ts:133-138` asserts the admin's account row has NO `issuer` own-property ("sys_account.issuer retired with better-auth 1.7.3 — nothing should still be writing it"); only its header comment changed.
- Left untouched on purpose, each read: the other `issuer` hits in `identity-auth.json` are the OIDC discovery-document `issuer` (`:178`, `:233`, `:235`, `:250`, `:275`) and the TOTP otpauth label `issuer + account` (`:1287`, `:1302`) — different concepts, correct. `areas/approvals.json`'s hits are all in `history` entries or closed-by-fixture `knownGaps` text — the correct steady state, not in scope. `areas/ai.json:697/719` is the OAuth issuer URL in a boot-log warning — unrelated.

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 0: "OK — 15 areas, 265 items ... symbol anchors: 619/637 resolved ... 17 file floors held".
- Anchor census unchanged by this diff: `areas/identity-auth.json` 83 against floor 82, `FOLLOW-UPS.md` 4 against floor 2. No floor or ledger moved. (`identity-auth.json` has one anchor of headroom — the new migration citations are bare paths, which add and remove no anchor.)
